review: W77 receipt explainer and finish hook integration
findings: Receipt eligibility is based on a real logged action entry, same source/document identity, and exact current operation revision. Generic Done text without applied lines is not used to infer an edit.

The finishCore apply path publishes synchronously through operationPublish. The review replay made the apply effect increment the source revision; operationPublish refreshed the publishing ticket to that post-apply revision, and the action-specific receipt remained explainable.

A later failed-only attempt is logged after the prior success and is the newest eligible entry. The explainer reported the failed attempt and did not reuse the earlier roof-finish success as the latest change.
Undo/replace flags and manual zone-revision changes refuse stale explanations. Source generation replacement also refuses to describe the prior-source receipt.

Mixed action-and-explanation phrasing is not consumed by the read-only receipt handler; the full action wording reaches the regular ask route without applying an extra mutation in this controlled test.

existing_actual_route_contract.coverage: Phrase classification plus applied, partial, failed, undone, superseded, generic draft, stale source, manual revision, mixed-action, and guidance routes.

checks: revision-changing finishCore apply updates the publishing receipt ticket
newer failed-only attempt supersedes older successful action in explanation
mixed action remains on the regular action route

limits: The controller harness uses controlled document/revision and applyQueue stubs; it proves route logic, not native paint output or browser installation.
Undo/refusal paths are exercised with harness state flags and revision changes, not a native Undo gesture.
